name: Clockwork Observatory
description: A steampunk observatory at night. A brass telescope tracks the sky through the dome's open slit while the dome turns on its rail, meshed gears whose teeth truly interlock drive the machinery, a long-case clock swings its pendulum and rings an automaton bell every quarter hour, an orrery shows the planets in today's positions, oil lamps flicker, steam hisses from a valve and meteors cross the Milky Way. Code-drawn, entirely offline.
author: seeWallpaper
